model_output.verdict: An ICU nurse with clear patient-care experience and a few contributions that need more detail.
write_up: Your resume points clearly to Staff Nurse, Medical ICU work. A recruiter can see your patient load, the therapies you manage, and your charge nurse and precepting work. It gives them enough to move forward with a couple of questions.

The direct-care line is a strong model: it places your work with critically ill patients in a 24-bed medical ICU and gives your patient load per shift. Your Arizona license and CCRN are also easy to find.
Let's start with the sepsis committee. Add what you contributed there, then make your part in telemetry rapid response calls more concrete. You don't need to force a number onto every line.
